facts.business: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited operates in the media and entertainment sector, providing broadcasting services, digital streaming via ZEE5, and content creation across television, movies, and music.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Digital business delivered positive EBITDA on a comparable basis in FY26, in line with guidance provided at the beginning of the year.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Independent Investigation Committee constituted to review allegations; Board concluded no material irregularities, transactions in normal course; settlement applications filed with SEBI under consideration.

key_risks: Regulatory investigations and SEBI proceedings related to alleged irregularities
Dependence on advertising and subscription revenue in a shifting media landscape
High competition in digital streaming and content creation
Foreign currency exposure from FCCBs issued in USD
facts.related_party_note: Related party payables referenced in notes 44(d)(ii)(A) and 37, and note 46; other payables include related party amounts.
